about: All 456 HyperFrames registry items, classified for a vertical talking-head reel; the usable ones are rendered alone on a real reel (Ukrainian text, brand colours via scripts/brand_recolor.py, over the video, never moving the person). status: ready = checked in the frame, suggested; replace = checked, English text baked in: swap the listed strings with card "replace"; full_only = works only as a whole-frame takeover for 2-3 s, suggested marked «на весь кадр»; manual = works but small or niche, only when the person asks; candidate = not checked in the frame yet, never suggested; skip = don't use (reason in note). keep_ui = a real product UI (ChatGPT, Claude, iPhone...), keeps its own colours. card = placement copied into the edit.json card by build_reel (card fields win).
